en: Hello! I'm one of Professor Oak's aides. Shall I see how many kinds of Pokémon you've caught?
{var:CAUGHT} kinds! That's remarkable. The Professor asked me to give you this.
A Pokémon holding an Exp. Share gains experience from every battle, even if it never steps out.
I'm watching the sea for Professor Oak. You'd be amazed at what flies over it.
Very well. Drop by whenever you like.
{var:CAUGHT} kinds so far. Come back once you've caught fifty, and I'll have something special for you.
Looking through the binoculars... A great blue bird is flying far out over the sea!
